metadata.coordinate_system: Cartesian SVG User Units (px), Origin Top-Left (0, 0)

geometric_invariants.statement: bodyBox is strictly a subset of visualBox (bodyBox <= visualBox)
geometric_invariants.mathematical_proof: visualBounds expands bodyBounds by physical appendages (supports, nozzles, casing). For all x: visual.x <= body.x and (body.x + body.w) <= (visual.x + visual.w)

geometric_invariants.statement: visualBox is strictly a subset of collisionBox (visualBox <= collisionBox)
geometric_invariants.mathematical_proof: collisionBounds = min/max(visualBounds, labelBounds, telemetryBounds, portBounds) + clearance. By construction collisionBox strictly encloses visualBox.

geometric_invariants.statement: Rotational AABB expands via trigonometric projection without clipping
geometric_invariants.mathematical_proof: w = (width * |cos theta| + height * |sin theta|) * scale; h = (width * |sin theta| + height * |cos theta|) * scale

geometric_invariants.statement: Plaques and labels do not overlap equipment core body or ports
geometric_invariants.mathematical_proof: Dynamic TelemetryLayoutZone selection evaluates candidate zones (BOTTOM, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT) and falls back to non-conflicting zone if target zone is obstructed.
geometric_invariants.empirical_result: VERIFIED on crowded reactor and compressor layouts
